elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1 million per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause requires comprehensive general liability coverage of at least USD 1 million but does not specify that the limit applies per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 2 million in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional errors and omissions insurance of only USD 1 million.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5 million when Vendor processes Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 2 million. Processing of Customer Data is not demonstrably absent, so the conditional requirement cannot be treated as satisfied.

elements.element: Workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Contractor must maintain workers' compensation insurance in the amount required by statute throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Upon Customer's request, Vendor must provide certificates of insurance.
elements.evidence: At Company's request, Contractor may provide certificates or other acceptable evidence, so the clause does not unconditionally require certificates specifically.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions insurance of at least USD 1 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 1 million.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 2 million throughout the Agreement term.

result.reason: The operative amendment reaches the fallback by retaining USD 1 million E&O coverage and adding USD 2 million cyber/privacy coverage. It does not reach the preferred limits or specify the required CGL occurrence and aggregate structure. The amendment is substantively limited to the needed cyber coverage and leaves unrelated commercial terms effective.
